insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: 2 Lacs, 3 Lacs, 4 Lacs, 5 Lacs, 7 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores, 3 Crores, 4 Crores, 5 Crores, 6 Crores

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One NXT)
great.explanation: Room rent charges are covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured without any category restriction or daily cap. This means you can choose any room type without worrying about proportionate deductions.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Super Reload: 2X - Day 1; 2nd Claim Onwards - Unlimited Times (upto Base Sum Insured)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One NXT); Section C.8 Super Reload
great.explanation: The policy provides unlimited reloads of the Base Sum Insured after exhaustion, starting from day one and for subsequent claims. This offers strong protection against multiple hospitalizations within the policy year.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days before hospitalization are covered. This longer pre-hospitalization period helps cover related diagnostic and treatment costs better than standard plans.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Modern Procedures / Treatments: Actuals up to Sum Insured for listed procedures
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table; Section C.1.1.1(e) indicative list
great.explanation: Listed modern treatments are covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured without sub-limits. This means you get full coverage for advanced procedures without restrictive caps.

great.name: Renewal Bonus
great.quote: Super Credit (increases irrespective of claim): 100% of Base Sum Insured per year, up to 500% of Base Sum Insured (up to Max of 3 Cr under this benefit)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table; Section C.10.8 Super Credit
great.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 100% of the base amount each year regardless of claims, up to 500%. This is better than typical no-claim bonuses that reduce or reset after claims.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: D.1.3 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03) ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: There is a 30-day waiting period for illnesses from policy start, but accidents are covered immediately. This is the industry standard initial waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: A 24-month waiting period applies for specified diseases and procedures. This matches the typical market standard for such conditions.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Home-based treatment that requires hospital-level care is covered, subject to conditions like minimum duration and medical necessity. This is a useful benefit for non-hospitalized care.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: items in List I, II, III & IV will be excluded unless forms a part of In-patient hospitalization.
bad.reference: Section D.2.5 Non-Medical Expenses; Annexure I
bad.explanation: Many consumables and non-medical items are excluded by default unless you opt for an additional cover. This can lead to out-of-pocket expenses for common hospital supplies.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 180 days, which is standard but not best-in-class. Longer coverage beyond 180 days would be preferable.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Super Reload ... We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
bad.explanation: The policy offers a reload benefit but does not explicitly provide a traditional restore benefit covering same or unrelated illnesses. This may limit some types of coverage replenishment.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... then the Policyholder / Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim arising in such regard.
bad.reference: Section C.10.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-pay applies only if you opt for the PPN discount and receive treatment outside PPN hospitals. The default co-pay for the base plan is not clearly stated and should be confirmed in your Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: PED Waiting Period
unclear.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of years / months as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table
unclear.reference: Section D.1.1 Pre-Existing Diseases (PED) (Code-Excl01); Annexure III (shows 'Pre-Existing Diseases Waiting Period: 3 Years')
unclear.explanation: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases depends on your Policy Schedule, with the product table indicating 3 years. You should verify the exact period applicable to your variant.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
